rules.history: NA495 geometry is not verified Korean1998 geography

rules.identity: new authored extensions, stable IDs keyed by original source model
rules.materials: guaranteed common collection/crafting drops; no random essential gate
rules.population: several clusters in each selected hunting layout; existing monster IDs reused, named source species not duplicated

basis: four playable classes, fixed six pre99 growth intervals
